patterns: Where can I get mental health support?
Can I talk to someone about stress?
I need someone to talk to
responses: Yes, EMU offers free and confidential counseling services to all students. Visit the Counseling Services page at [emu.edu/counseling](https://emu.edu/counseling) to schedule an appointment.
You can access mental health support through EMU’s Counseling Services. They’re here to help with stress, anxiety, or personal issues.

patterns: I need help with my classes
Where can I get academic help?
responses: Yes, EMU offers tutoring, writing support, and study help through the Academic Success Center. Visit [emu.edu/academics/success](https://emu.edu/academics/success).
Tutoring and academic support are available! Reach out to the Academic Success Center to get connected.

patterns: I have a disability, can I get help?
responses: Yes, EMU provides disability support through the Director of Academic Access. Visit [emu.edu/academics/success](https://emu.edu/academics/success) to learn more and request accommodations.
Students with disabilities can receive academic accommodations and accessibility support. Contact the Academic Success Center for more info.

patterns: I need someone to help me with a problem
Where can I report an issue?
What if I'm having trouble with a professor?
responses: If you’re facing an issue, you can speak with the Dean of Students or the Student Life office for help and advocacy.
Student Life and the Dean’s office are here to support you if you're having concerns or problems on campus.

patterns: What if I have a crisis?
Who do I call in an emergency?
responses: For immediate crises, call campus security or 911. For emotional crises, EMU Counseling Services offers support. After-hours resources are listed at [emu.edu/counseling](https://emu.edu/counseling).
In emergencies, call 911 or campus security. For emotional support, contact Counseling Services or a 24/7 crisis line.

patterns: How do I contact student support?
Who do I reach out to for help?
Is there a student support number?
responses: You can reach Student Life and support services through EMU’s main office or specific departments. For counseling, email counselingservices@emu.edu or call 540-432-4317.
Check the EMU website’s student support or counseling section for contact details, or visit the Student Life office in person.
